name: auth_status
description: Reports whether the current user is authenticated and what tool permissions are granted. Requires no specific Entra role.

authenticated.description: Whether the user has a valid authenticated session

identity.description: User principal name if authenticated, null otherwise

tenant_id.description: Entra tenant ID if authenticated, null otherwise

permissions.description: List of granted permission domains (e.g., flow.read, flow.write, flow.execute)

available_tools.description: List of MCP tool names the user is authorized to use
